plugins.description: Keystone-driven pack for recurring knowledge work: company-setup interviews once and writes a shared company-profile.md that the other twelve skills read, covering inbox triage, follow-ups, invoices, expenses, CRM hygiene, scheduling, meeting notes, standups, weekly reviews, task capture, document drafting and research briefs. Read-and-propose: the skills draft and the user sends.
